scripts.db:setup: node scripts/setup-local-env.mjs && docker compose up -d --wait postgres && pnpm db:generate && pnpm db:migrate
scripts.release:check: pnpm check && pnpm build && pnpm api:smoke
scripts.test: node --test tests/workspace.test.mjs tests/db-foundation.test.mjs tests/shared-contracts.test.mjs tests/release-readiness.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @quanti/api test && pnpm --filter @quanti/desktop test && pnpm --filter @quanti/desktop tauri:test
scripts.check: node scripts/validate-workspace.mjs && pnpm --filter @quanti/db db:validate && node --test tests/workspace.test.mjs tests/db-foundation.test.mjs tests/shared-contracts.test.mjs tests/release-readiness.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @quanti/api test && pnpm --filter @quanti/desktop test && pnpm --filter @quanti/desktop tauri:test && pnpm --filter @quanti/desktop tauri:check
